Authored, Written and Composed by The Local Train (Paras Thakur, Ramit Mehra, Sahil Sarin) & Raman Negi.

The first single release from The Local Train Aaoge Tum Kabhi took a long time in the making.The video was shot and then reshot and replanned quite a number of times. The final product has 7 different shows across 5 states that the band played and shot live!
